purpose: Read-only diagnostic of zero-cost Ubuntu capability supply for XLSX creation after output-format-aware discovery repair.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m.search_apt_packages('xlsx',limit=30)
print(json.dumps({'queries':out.get('queries'),'candidates':out.get('candidates',[])[:30]},sort_keys=True))
print('XLSX_SUPPLIER_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE')
PY
